# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities affecting Hanzo Dev or Hanzo AI-operated infrastructure to
[security@dev.hanzo.ai](mailto:security@dev.hanzo.ai). Please do not disclose them publicly until we have had
a reasonable opportunity to investigate and remediate them.

See the [full security policy](https://dev.hanzo.ai/security-policy) for reporting details, scope,
and safe harbor terms for good-faith research.
